Let me work through this step by step.

**<missing 1>**: After defining $a_n = a_1 + f(n)$, we need expressions for $a_{n+1}$ and $a_{n+k}$. Looking at expression 1: $a_{n+1}=a_{1}+f(n+1)$ - this fits.

**<missing 2>**: Similarly, we need $a_{n+k}=a_{1}+f(n+k)$ which is expression 10.

**<missing 3>**: We need to define $g(j)$. Expression 20 shows $g(j)=a_{1}+f(n+j)-a_{n}=a_{1}+f(n+j)-a_{1}-f(n)$ which simplifies to $g(j)=f(n+j)-f(n)$. This is expression 20.

**<missing 4>**: We're talking about coefficients of $P(a_n)$, so expression 7 fits.

**<missing 5>**: For positive coefficients, we need $g(j) \geq 0$, which is expression 22.

**<missing 6>**: The formula for P is expression 18: $P=a_{n}^{k}+C_{k-1}a_{n}^{k-1}+...+C_{1}a_{n}+\prod_{j=1}^{k} g(j) = P(a_{n})$

**<missing 7>**: We need the condition $a_{n}+g(j)=a_{n+j}=a_{1}+f(n+j)$, which is expression 14.

**<missing 8>**: Solving for g(j), we get $g(j)=f(n+j)-f(n)$, which is part of expression 11.

**<missing 9>**: The condition $g(j)=f(n+j)-f(n)\geq 0$ is expression 11.

**<missing 10>**: We need $a_{1}=a_{1}+f(1)$, which is expression 16.

**<missing 11>**: The expression $g(j)=f(n+j)-f(n)$ which is expression 8.

**<missing 12>**: Setting $f(n)$ as a line: $f(n)=mn+b$, which is expression 15.

**<missing 13>**: The intercept at $n=0$, which is expression 9.

**<missing 14>**: $f(1)=m+b=0$, which is expression 4.

**<missing 15>**: This gives $b=-m$, which is expression 21.

**<missing 16>**: The function becomes $f(n)=mn-m=(n-1)m$, which is expression 19.

**<missing 17>**: We need $m\geq 0 \mid m \in \mathbb{Z}$, which is expression 3.

**<missing 18>**: Now we compute $g(j)=f(n+j)-f(n)=(n+j-1)m-(n-1)m=jm$, which is expression 6.

**<missing 19>**: The product formula $\prod_{j=1}^{k}\left ( a_{n}+jm \right )=P(a_{n})=a_{n}^{k}+C_{k-1}a_{n}^{k-1}+...+C_{1}a_{n}+k!m^{k}$, which is expression 2.

**<missing 20>**: $C_{0}=k!m^{k}$, which is expression 5.

**<missing 21>**: $P=\prod_{j=1}^{k}\left ( a_{n+j} \right ) = \prod_{j=1}^{k}\left ( a_{n}+g(j)) \right )$, which is expression 13.

**<missing 22>**: $a_{n}=a_{1}+(n-1)m$, which is expression 24.

**<missing 23>**: $\forall m\geq 0 \mid m \in \mathbb{Z}$, which is expression 23.

**<missing 24>**: $a_{1} \geq 1 \mid a_{1} \in \mathbb{Z}$, which is expression 12.

Answer: 1, 10, 20, 7, 22, 18, 14, 11, 11, 16, 8, 15, 9, 4, 21, 19, 3, 6, 2, 5, 13, 24, 23, 12
